_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Depot Maintenance Manual (Type II)
summary: Specifies the format and content preparation instructions for a Depot Maintenance Manual (Type II) that combines theory textbook and maintenance/troubleshooting content into a single manual.
use_relationship:
The maintenance manual combines the elements of a theory textbook manual (Type II) and a maintenance/troubleshooting manual (Type III) into a single manual.  It is generally used in lieu of manual Type III for minor units of equipment where the complete full maintenance coverage can be bound in a single manual and a separate limited maintenance manual (Type I) is provided for limited maintenance.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract, and paragraphs 2-1, 3-1, 4-1, 4-2, and 5-2 of DS-56, Data Standard for the Preparation of INFOSEC Technical Manuals.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval date and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as stated herein.  DS-56, Data Standard for the Preparation of INFOSEC Technical Manuals, current edition is available at the National Security Agency, 9800 Savage Rd, Suite 6718, Fort Meade, Md. 20755-6718; Attn: I8222.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Depot Maintenance Manual (Type II) shall be in accordance with the format and style requirements of paragraphs 2-1, 3-1, and 4-1 of DS-56.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The textbook content shall be in accordance with paragraphs 4-2 and 5-2 of DS-56.
